**1 — Scene:** A leafy salad with cucumber, dark olives, shaved hard cheese, and a few pale golden pieces that look like croutons.

**2 — Vessel:** A shallow oval serving bowl, approximately 30 × 23 cm. Its area is roughly equivalent to a **26 cm round plate**: 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**. The plate at the left edge is excluded.

**3 — Items:** Mixed salad leaves, sliced cucumber, dark olives, Parmesan-like cheese shavings, and probable croutons. No separate pool of dressing or clearly measurable oil is visible, so none is added.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** Area shares partition the food-covered surface to avoid counting overlapping ingredients twice. Heights represent each ingredient’s accumulated thickness.

| Item | Vessel area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed leaves | 25% | 133 cm² × 3 cm = 399 ml | 0.15 | 60 | 20 | 12 kcal |
| Cucumber | 29% | 154 cm² × 2 cm = 308 ml | 0.60 | 185 | 15 | 28 kcal |
| Dark olives | 14% | 74 cm² × 1.5 cm = 111 ml | 0.60 | 67 | 145 | 97 kcal |
| Hard cheese shavings | 14% | 74 cm² × 0.6 cm = 44 ml | 1.00 | 44 | 420 | 185 kcal |
| Probable croutons | 3% | 16 cm² × 1.2 cm = 19 ml | 0.90 | 17 | 400 | 68 kcal |

**Area check:** 25 + 29 + 14 + 14 + 3 = **85%**, consistent with the visible food coverage and exposed rim.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **373 g and 390 kcal** is plausible for this substantial salad. Cucumber supplies most of the weight; cheese and olives supply most of the energy. The crouton identification and any unobservable dressing are sources of uncertainty.
